prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Custom companion photo upload split layout redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen using a split view layout to present upload options side-by-side with clear photo recommendations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split"}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop tray pet quick toggle guide screen: Add a new screen after home intro guiding users on how to control and show or hide their pet using the system tray.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_tray_guide"], "new_tray_guide": {"headline": "System Tray Quick Controls", "body": "Access your desktop companion anytime from the system tray menu in your taskbar."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion trait personality matching quiz flow: Insert a short personality quiz sub-flow screen prior to picking a companion to help guide character selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_trait_quiz", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_quiz": {"headline": "Personality Match Quiz", "body": "Answer a quick question to match with the companion personality that best fits your desktop workflow."}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story screen spotlight layout redesign: Redesign the onboarding story screen using a focused spotlight layout to highlight companion benefits immediately.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing pet restoration account sign-in note: Add a prominent sign-in hint explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account data reset.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to safely sync and restore your existing desktop pets across sessions."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Live background companion rendering tip ticker: Display a dynamic tip delay sequence on the waiting screen while background companion rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Companion journey path selection headline refresh: Refresh the main headline on the path selection screen to emphasize instant companion setup.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Desktop Companion Experience", "body": "Choose a preset starter pet or create a custom companion for your workspace."}}
7: [finish, incentive] Home intro desktop pet launch checklist component: Add an interactive checklist component on the home intro screen detailing final desktop activation steps.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Activate pet visibility on desktop screen", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Background generation completion desktop notification alert: Enable desktop notification alerts on the wait screen so users receive a prompt when pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Compact layout for choose path screen: Update the choose path screen to a compact layout to reduce visual clutter and display path options clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "compact"}}
